bug_semantics: An untrusted MessagePack payload deserialized as a dynamically resolved [Union] reaches emitted BuildDeserialize IL. The formatter reads a two-element union array and attacker-controlled key; a known key recursively invokes the selected subtype formatter, while an unknown key skips the attacker-controlled value. The generated frame did not enter MessagePackSecurity's depth budget or decrement reader.Depth, so nested unions and skip work bypassed the configured object-graph depth guard and could recurse to process-terminating StackOverflowException.
flaw_origin: Commit 700058579a35ef8a7efdff598e5daf618a74166f is the smallest public first-writer that changed DynamicUnionResolver from NotImplemented generated methods to a working emitted deserializer containing the recursive subtype call and unknown-key skip. Its immediate parent 786844d909141cd0e48d53f0bc722db1c2e54bb2 contained only unreachable/commented builder code behind NotImplemented stubs. Later commit a145b7cc7dff745ce3899a7fa8bf38ccba5cfeb7 introduced the graph-depth policy across other recursive formatters without modifying DynamicUnionResolver, but it did not first write the vulnerable runtime path.
